## 更新内容

### 播放队列

- 队列页去掉了「播放队列」大标题、数量标签和与左侧重复的「正在播放」卡片。顶部改为「接下来播放」，下方显示歌曲数与总时长，例如「6 首 · 约 23 分钟」。
- 每首歌显示「歌手 · 专辑」。时长旁的图标标出歌词类型：蓝色为逐行歌词，灰色为普通歌词，没有歌词不显示；鼠标悬停在图标上会提示类型。
- 鼠标悬停在某首歌上时，封面显示播放图标，行尾出现「⋯」按钮，菜单里有「播放这首」和「复制歌名和歌手」。
- 点击队列里的歌后，封面上显示转圈并淡化该行，直到 Cider 切到这首歌；超过 4 秒未切换则重新读取队列。
- 读屏软件会读出每首歌的歌名、歌手、时长和歌词类型。

### 队列刷新

- 队列读取与播放状态刷新分开。Cider 的队列接口响应慢时，进度、换曲和歌词不再跟着卡住。
- 换曲或执行播放操作后立即重新读取队列；平时每 3 秒同步一次（之前为 5 秒）。
- 播放状态只请求 `is-playing`，去掉了每秒一次、没有用到的音量请求。
- 换曲后读不到队列时，不再显示上一个歌单的内容，而是提示「Cider 没有返回当前的播放队列」。

### 退出

- 退出时任务栏歌词先淡出再关闭，不再一下子消失。菜单退出、托盘退出、随 Cider 退出，以及未开启「关闭时最小化到托盘」时点标题栏关闭，都走同一流程。
- 歌曲信息不可用（Cider 关闭、断开或停止播放）时，任务栏歌词也改为淡出后隐藏。

## 已知问题

- 播放 Apple Music 的 Favorite Songs 时，Cider 的队列接口不返回数据，队列页会显示上面的提示；播放普通歌单时正常。这需要 Cider 修复。

## 安装与升级

下载 `Lyrider_1.8.0.0_x64.msix` 和 `Lyrider.cer`，仅支持 Windows 11 x64。首次安装前，将证书导入当前用户的“受信任人”存储，再安装 MSIX：

```powershell
Import-Certificate -FilePath .\Lyrider.cer -CertStoreLocation Cert:\CurrentUser\TrustedPeople
Add-AppxPackage .\Lyrider_1.8.0.0_x64.msix
```

已有版本使用同一证书签名时，可直接安装新 MSIX 升级。安装包包含 .NET、Windows App SDK 运行时和中英文资源。Cider 插件 `Lyrider-Cider-Plugin_1.0.0.zip` 与 v1.6.1 相同，已安装的无需更新。

## 验证

- Release 构建 0 警告 0 错误；逻辑及服务测试（Release）：414/414 通过，新增队列解析、歌词类型、队列汇总等测试。
- 任务栏控件测试（Release）：76/76 通过；封面与任务栏封面集成测试：7/7、7/7 通过。

完整变更：[v1.7.0...v1.8.0](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.7.0...v1.8.0)

## Changes in English

### Play queue

- The queue page drops the large "Play Queue" title, the count badge and the "Now Playing" card that repeated the left side. It now opens with "Up Next" and a line with the song count and total length, such as "6 songs · about 23 min".
- Each song shows "Artist · Album". An icon next to the duration marks the lyrics type: blue for synced lyrics, gray for plain lyrics, none without lyrics. Hovering the icon names the type.
- Hovering a song shows a play icon on its cover and a "⋯" button with "Play this song" and "Copy title and artist".
- After clicking a song, its cover shows a spinner and the row dims until Cider switches to it; if that takes over 4 seconds, the queue is read again.
- Screen readers announce each song's title, artist, duration and lyrics type.

### Queue refresh

- Reading the queue is now separate from the playback refresh, so progress, track changes and lyrics no longer stall when Cider's queue endpoint is slow.
- The queue is read again right after a track change or playback command, and synced every 3 seconds otherwise (previously 5).
- Playback status only requests `is-playing`; the unused per-second volume request is gone.
- When the queue cannot be read after a track change, the previous playlist's queue is no longer shown; the page says "Cider didn't return the current queue" instead.

### Exiting

- On exit, the taskbar lyrics fade out before Lyrider closes instead of vanishing at once. Exiting from the menu, the tray, along with Cider, or via the title bar close button (when "minimize to tray on close" is off) all follow the same path.
- When song info becomes unavailable (Cider closed, disconnected or stopped), the taskbar lyrics also fade out before hiding.

### Known issue

- While playing Apple Music's Favorite Songs, Cider's queue endpoint returns no data, so the queue page shows the message above. Regular playlists work. This needs a fix in Cider.

### Installation and verification

Download `Lyrider_1.8.0.0_x64.msix` and `Lyrider.cer` for Windows 11 x64. For a first installation, import the certificate into the current user's Trusted People store using the commands above, then install the MSIX. Existing installations signed with the same certificate can upgrade directly. The Cider plugin `Lyrider-Cider-Plugin_1.0.0.zip` is unchanged from v1.6.1.

The Release build had no warnings or errors. All 414 logic/service tests, all 76 taskbar widget tests and both sets of 7 artwork integration tests passed.

Full changelog: [v1.7.0...v1.8.0](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.7.0...v1.8.0)
